name: Deepgram
description: A Deepgram AI provider (Speech-to-Text and Text-to-Speech) for the AI module. Uses the Key module for credentials.
project_description:
Deepgram is a superior speech to text/transcript service that takes audio and transcribes it. The module works as a provider for the AI module making it possible to create transcripts from audio files and also do speech to text in a very natural way for the English language.

 This means that any third party library utilizing the AI module for speech-to-text or text-to-speech will make the Deepgram module available.

 For the AI Interpolator this replaces the Deepgram transcribe rules and makes them generically available for the new AI Automator.

 For more information on how to use the AI Automator (previously AI Interpolator), check https://workflows-of-ai.com .

 Back to top 

 Features 
 
 It can do simple text to speech. 
 It can do advanced transcriptions with exact timestamp, diarization, smart wording and more. 
 It can generate very realistic speech from text in the English language. 
 
 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 
 Requires an account at Deepgram . They have free trials. 
 Requires the AI module. 
 
 Back to top 

 How to use as AI Automator type 
 
 Install the AI module . 
 Install this module. 
 Visit /admin/config/google_places/settings and add your api keys from your Google Places account. 
 Create some entity or node type with a simple text field. 
 Create an file field and set mp3. 
 Enable AI Automator checkbox and configure it. 
 Create an entity of the type you generated, fill in some text and save. 
 The audio file be filled out.
